item.title: Despite specter of ICE looming, fans welcome Haiti-US match in Cincinnati
item.description: As Haiti and the United States national soccer teams prepare to take the field for the second leg of their Concacaf Nations League match-up on Nov.17, the stadium they will play in sits just 16 miles from an Immigration and Customs Enforcement ( ICE ) office.

item.title: House Democrats prepare to elect leaders for the new Congress as party pushes for change
item.description: House Democrats are preparing to elect their leadership slate for the new Congress. The private voting Wednesday will test Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries and the generation of new leaders.

item.title: Divided appeals court blocks Pentagon from expelling several transgender troops from US military
item.description: A federal appeals court has blocked the Pentagon from forcing several transgender troops out of the military, after finding President Donald Trump’s ban was unlawfully imposed.
